title: kitchen._on_sales_order_line_voided
description: Payload of the `sales.order.line_voided` event (contract of the sales module, SALES-F20): the till voided a line of an open check that was already sent to the kitchen, with a mandatory reason, so its dish is struck on the line (kitchen#161). Sales only announces a line it really voided. additionalProperties=true on purpose: the relay delivers the emitter's payload AS IS, `sender` included (kitchen#29). Idempotent: a redelivery only sees voided dishes and writes nothing.
